explanations: The gripper moves to point 'oed' for a side grasp, which is suitable for pulling a drawer horizontally.
The drawer is pulled using the 'pull' primitive along the 'sov' surface, with 'parallel' force direction to slide the drawer out.
The action uses a pivot at point 'oed', which is the handle of the drawer, to facilitate a smooth opening motion.
Force threshold is set to 'medium' to ensure enough force to overcome the friction of the drawer without damaging the contents or the drawer itself.
Precision is 'high' because accurate alignment with the handle is necessary to avoid slipping or jerking motions.
